traditions.KJV: Because ye have said ,

15.english_reference: The LORD hath raised us up prophets in Babylon

traditions.WLC: הֵקִ֨ים לָ֧ נוּ יְהוָ֛ה נְבִאִ֖ים בָּבֶֽלָ ה
traditions.LXX: Κατέστησεν ἡμῖν Κύριος προφήτας ἐν Βαβυλῶνι ·
traditions.VUL: Suscitávit nobis Dóminus prophétas in Babylóne :
traditions.KJV: The LORD hath raised us up prophets in Babylon ;

16.english_reference: [ Know ] that thus saith the LORD of the king that sitteth upon the throne of David

traditions.WLC: כִּי כֹ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אֶל הַ מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ הַ יּוֹשֵׁב֙ אֶל כִּסֵּ֣א דָוִ֔ד
traditions.VUL: quia hæc dicit Dóminus ad regem , qui sedet super sólium David ,
traditions.KJV: [ Know ] that thus saith the LORD of the king that sitteth upon the throne of David ,

16.english_reference: and of all the people that dwelleth in this city

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶל כָּל הָ עָ֔ם הַ יּוֹשֵׁ֖ב בָּ עִ֣יר הַ זֹּ֑את
traditions.VUL: et ad omnem pópulum habitatórem urbis huius ,
traditions.KJV: and of all the people that dwelleth in this city , [ and ]

16.english_reference: of your brethren that are not gone forth with you into captivity

traditions.WLC: אֲחֵי כֶ֕ם אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא יָצְא֥וּ אִתְּ כֶ֖ם בַּ גּוֹלָֽה
traditions.VUL: ad fratres vestros , qui non sunt egréssi vobíscum in transmigratiónem :
traditions.KJV: of your brethren that are not gone forth with you into captivity ;

17.english_reference: Thus saith the LORD of hosts ;

traditions.WLC: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת
traditions.VUL: Hæc dicit Dóminus exercítuum :
traditions.KJV: Thus saith the LORD of hosts ;

17.english_reference: Behold , I will send upon them the sword , the famine , and the pestilence ,

traditions.WLC: הִנְ נִי֙ מְשַׁלֵּ֣חַ בָּ֔ ם אֶת הַ חֶ֖רֶב אֶת הָ רָעָ֣ב וְ אֶת הַ דָּ֑בֶר
traditions.VUL: Ecce mittam in eos gládium , et famem , et pestem :
traditions.KJV: Behold , I will send upon them the sword , the famine , and the pestilence ,

17.english_reference: and will make them like vile figs ,

traditions.WLC: וְ נָתַתִּ֣י אוֹתָ֗ ם כַּ תְּאֵנִים֙ הַ שֹּׁ֣עָרִ֔ים
traditions.VUL: et ponam eos quasi ficus malas ,
traditions.KJV: and will make them like vile figs ,

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא תֵאָכַ֖לְנָה
traditions.VUL: quæ cómedi non possunt ,
traditions.KJV: that can not be eaten ,

traditions.WLC: מֵ רֹֽעַ
traditions.VUL: eo quod péssimæ sint .
traditions.KJV: they are so evil .

18.english_reference: And I will persecute them with the sword, with the famine, and with the pestilence

traditions.WLC: וְ רָֽדַפְתִּי֙ אַֽחֲרֵי הֶ֔ם בַּ חֶ֖רֶב בָּ רָעָ֣ב וּ בַ דָּ֑בֶר
traditions.VUL: Et pérsequar eos in gládio , et in fame , et in pestiléntia :
traditions.KJV: And I will persecute them with the sword , with the famine , and with the pestilence ,

18.english_reference: and will deliver them to be removed to all the kingdoms of the earth

traditions.WLC: וּ נְתַתִּ֨י ם ל זועה לְ כֹ֣ל מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָ אָ֗רֶץ
traditions.VUL: et dabo eos in vexatiónem univérsis regnis terræ :
traditions.KJV: and will deliver them to be removed to all the kingdoms of the earth ,

18.english_reference: to be a curse, and an astonishment, and an hissing, and a reproach, among all the nations whither I have driven them

traditions.WLC: לְ אָלָ֤ה וּ לְ שַׁמָּה֙ וְ לִ שְׁרֵקָ֣ה וּ לְ חֶרְפָּ֔ה בְּ כָל הַ גּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁר הִדַּחְתִּ֥י ם שָֽׁם
traditions.VUL: in maledictiónem , et in stupórem , et in síbilum , et in oppróbrium cunctis géntibus , ad quas ego eiéci eos :
traditions.KJV: to be a curse , and an astonishment , and an hissing , and a reproach , among all the nations whither I have driven them :

19.english_reference: Because they have not hearkened to my words, saith the LORD

traditions.WLC: תַּ֛חַת אֲשֶֽׁר לֹא שָׁמְע֥וּ אֶל דְּבָרַ֖ י נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.VUL: eo quod non audíerint verba mea , dicit Dóminus ,
traditions.KJV: Because they have not hearkened to my words , saith the LORD ,

19.english_reference: which I sent unto them by my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending [ them ]

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁר֩ שָׁלַ֨חְתִּי אֲלֵי הֶ֜ם אֶת עֲבָדַ֤ י הַ נְּבִאִים֙ הַשְׁכֵּ֣ם וְ שָׁלֹ֔חַ
traditions.VUL: quæ misi ad eos per servos meos prophétas , de nocte consúrgens et mittens :
traditions.KJV: which I sent unto them by my servants the prophets , rising up early and sending [ them ] ;

19.english_reference: but ye would not hear, saith the LORD

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹ֥א שְׁמַעְתֶּ֖ם נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
traditions.VUL: et non audístis , dicit Dóminus .
traditions.KJV: but ye would not hear , saith the LORD .

20.english_reference: Hear ye therefore the word of the LORD

traditions.WLC: וְ אַתֶּ֖ם שִׁמְע֣וּ דְבַר יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.VUL: Vos ergo audíte verbum Dómini
traditions.KJV: Hear ye therefore the word of the LORD ,

20.english_reference: all ye of the captivity, whom I have sent from Jerusalem to Babylon

traditions.WLC: כָּל הַ֨ גּוֹלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר שִׁלַּ֥חְתִּי מִ ירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בָּבֶֽלָ ה
traditions.VUL: omnis transmigrátio , quam emísi de Ierúsalem in Babylónem .
traditions.KJV: all ye of the captivity , whom I have sent from Jerusalem to Babylon :

21.english_reference: Thus saith the LORD of hosts , the God of Israel ,

traditions.WLC: כֹּֽה אָמַר֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל
traditions.LXX: οὕτως εἶπεν Κύριος
traditions.VUL: Hæc dicit Dóminus exercítuum , Deus Israel ,
traditions.KJV: Thus saith the LORD of hosts , the God of Israel ,

21.english_reference: of Ahab the son of Kolaiah , and of Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah ,

traditions.WLC: אֶל אַחְאָ֤ב בֶּן קֽוֹלָיָה֙ וְ אֶל צִדְקִיָּ֣הוּ בֶן מַֽעֲשֵׂיָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: ἐπὶ Ἀχιὰβ καὶ ἐπὶ Σεδεκίαν
traditions.VUL: ad Achab fílium Cóliæ , et ad Sedecíam fílium Maasíæ ,
traditions.KJV: of Ahab the son of Kolaiah , and of Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah ,

21.english_reference: which prophesy a lie unto you in my name ;

traditions.WLC: הַֽ נִּבְּאִ֥ים לָ כֶ֛ם בִּ שְׁמִ֖ י שָׁ֑קֶר
traditions.VUL: qui prophétant vobis in nómine meo mendáciter :
traditions.KJV: which prophesy a lie unto you in my name ;

21.english_reference: Behold , I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon ;

traditions.WLC: הִנְ נִ֣י נֹתֵ֣ן אֹתָ֗ ם בְּ יַד֙ נְבֽוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֣ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל
traditions.LXX: Ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ δίδωμι αὐτοὺς εἰς χεῖρας βασιλέως Βαβυλῶνος ,
traditions.VUL: Ecce ego tradam eos in manus Nabuchodónosor regis Babylónis ,
traditions.KJV: Behold , I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon ;

21.english_reference: and he shall slay them before your eyes ;

traditions.WLC: וְ הִכָּ֖ ם לְ עֵינֵי כֶֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ πατάξει αὐτοὺς κατ᾽ ὀφθαλμοὺς ὑμῶν .
traditions.VUL: et percútiet eos in óculis vestris .
traditions.KJV: and he shall slay them before your eyes ;

22.english_reference: And of them shall be taken up a curse by all the captivity of Judah which [ are ] in Babylon ,

traditions.WLC: וְ לֻקַּ֤ח מֵ הֶם֙ קְלָלָ֔ה לְ כֹל֙ גָּל֣וּת יְהוּדָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּ בָבֶ֖ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ λήμψονται ἀπ᾽ αὐτῶν κατάραν ἐν πάσῃ τῇ ἀποικίᾳ Ἰούδα ἐν Βαβυλῶνι
traditions.VUL: Et assumétur ex eis maledíctio omni transmigratióni Iuda , quæ est in Babylóne ,
traditions.KJV: And of them shall be taken up a curse by all the captivity of Judah which [ are ] in Babylon ,

22.english_reference: saying , The LORD make thee like Zedekiah and like Ahab ,

traditions.WLC: לֵ אמֹ֑ר יְשִֽׂמְ ךָ֤ יְהוָה֙ כְּ צִדְקִיָּ֣הוּ וּ כְ אֶחָ֔ב
traditions.LXX: λέγοντες Ποιήσαι σε Κύριος ὡς Σεδεκίαν ἐποίησεν καὶ ὡς Ἀχιάβ ,
traditions.VUL: dicéntium : Ponat te Dóminus sicut Sedecíam et sicut Achab ,
traditions.KJV: saying , The LORD make thee like Zedekiah and like Ahab ,

22.english_reference: whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire ;

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁר קָלָ֥ ם מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל בָּ אֵֽשׁ
traditions.LXX: οὓς ἀπετηγάνισεν βασιλεὺς Βαβυλῶνος ἐν πυρί ,
traditions.VUL: quos frixit rex Babylónis in igne :
traditions.KJV: whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire ;

23.english_reference: Because they have committed villany in Israel ,

traditions.WLC: יַ֡עַן אֲשֶׁר֩ עָשׂ֨וּ נְבָלָ֜ה בְּ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל
traditions.LXX: δι᾽ ἣν ἐποίησαν ἀνομίαν ἐν Ἰσραήλ ,
traditions.VUL: pro eo quod fécerint stultítiam in Israel ,
traditions.KJV: Because they have committed villany in Israel ,

23.english_reference: and have committed adultery with their neighbours ’ wives ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְנַֽאֲפוּ֙ אֶת נְשֵׁ֣י רֵֽעֵי הֶ֔ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐμοιχῶντο τὰς γυναῖκας τῶν πολιτῶν αὐτῶν ,
traditions.VUL: et mœcháti sunt in uxóres amicórum suórum ,
traditions.KJV: and have committed adultery with their neighbours ’ wives ,

23.english_reference: and have spoken lying words in my name , which I have not commanded them ;

traditions.WLC: וַ יְדַבְּר֨וּ דָבָ֤ר בִּ שְׁמִ י֙ שֶׁ֔קֶר אֲשֶׁ֖ר ל֣וֹא צִוִּיתִ֑ ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ λόγον ἐχρημάτισαν ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου ὃν οὐ συνέταξα αὐτοῖς ,
traditions.VUL: et locúti sunt verbum in nómine meo mendáciter , quod non mandávi eis :
traditions.KJV: and have spoken lying words in my name , which I have not commanded them ;

23.english_reference: even I know , and [ am ] a witness ,

traditions.WLC: וְ אָנֹכִ֛י הו ידע וָ עֵ֖ד
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγὼ μάρτυς ,
traditions.VUL: ego sum iudex et testis ,
traditions.KJV: even I know , and [ am ] a witness ,

traditions.WLC: נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: φησὶν Κύριος .
traditions.VUL: dicit Dóminus .
traditions.KJV: saith the LORD .

24.english_reference: [ Thus ] shalt thou also speak to Shemaiah the Nehelamite , saying ,

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶל שְׁמַעְיָ֥הוּ הַ נֶּחֱלָמִ֖י תֹּאמַ֥ר לֵ אמֹֽר
traditions.LXX: Καὶ πρὸς Σαμαίαν τὸν Αἰλαμείτην ἐρεῖς
traditions.VUL: Et ad Semeíam Nehelamíten dices :
traditions.KJV: [ Thus ] shalt thou also speak to Shemaiah the Nehelamite , saying ,

25.english_reference: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts , the God of Israel , saying ,

traditions.WLC: כֹּֽה אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֧ה צְבָא֛וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵ אמֹ֑ר
traditions.VUL: Hæc dicit Dóminus exercítuum , Deus Israel :
traditions.KJV: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts , the God of Israel , saying ,

25.english_reference: Because thou hast sent letters in thy name unto all the people that [ are ] at Jerusalem ,

traditions.WLC: יַ֡עַן אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַתָּה֩ שָׁלַ֨חְתָּ בְ שִׁמְ כָ֜ה סְפָרִ֗ים אֶל כָּל הָ עָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּ ירוּשָׁלִַ֔ם
traditions.LXX: Οὐκ ἀπέστειλά σε τῷ ὀνόματί μου .
traditions.VUL: Pro eo quod misísti in nómine tuo libros ad omnem pópulum , qui est in Ierúsalem ,
traditions.KJV: Because thou hast sent letters in thy name unto all the people that [ are ] at Jerusalem ,

25.english_reference: and to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest , and to all the priests , saying ,

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶל צְפַנְיָ֤ה בֶן מַֽעֲשֵׂיָה֙ הַ כֹּהֵ֔ן וְ אֶ֥ל כָּל הַ כֹּהֲנִ֖ים לֵ אמֹֽר
traditions.LXX: καὶ πρὸς Σοφονίαν υἱὸν Μαασαίου τὸν ἱερέα εἰπέ
traditions.VUL: et ad Sophoníam fílium Maasíæ sacerdótem , et ad univérsos sacerdótes , dicens
traditions.KJV: and to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest , and to all the priests , saying ,

26.english_reference: The LORD hath made thee priest in the stead of Jehoiada the priest ,

traditions.WLC: יְהוָ֞ה נְתָנְ ךָ֣ כֹהֵ֗ן תַּ֚חַת יְהוֹיָדָ֣ע הַ כֹּהֵ֔ן
traditions.LXX: Κύριος ἔδωκέν σε εἰς ἱερέα ἀντὶ Ἰωδᾶε τοῦ ἱερέως ,
traditions.VUL: Dóminus dedit te sacerdótem pro Ióiade sacerdóte ,
traditions.KJV: The LORD hath made thee priest in the stead of Jehoiada the priest ,

26.english_reference: that ye should be officers in the house of the LORD , for every man [ that is ] mad , and maketh himself a prophet ,

traditions.WLC: לִֽ הְי֤וֹת פְּקִדִים֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה לְ כָל אִ֥ישׁ מְשֻׁגָּ֖ע וּ מִתְנַבֵּ֑א
traditions.LXX: γενέσθαι ἐπιστάτην ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ Κυρίου παντὶ ἀνθρώπῳ προφητεύοντι καὶ παντὶ ἀνθρώπῳ μαινομένῳ ,
traditions.VUL: ut sis dux in domo Dómini , super omnem virum arreptítium et prophetántem ,
traditions.KJV: that ye should be officers in the house of the LORD , for every man [ that is ] mad , and maketh himself a prophet ,

26.english_reference: that thou shouldest put him in prison , and in the stocks .

traditions.WLC: וְ נָתַתָּ֥ה אֹת֛ וֹ אֶל הַ מַּהְפֶּ֖כֶת וְ אֶל הַ צִּינֹֽק
traditions.LXX: καὶ δώσεις αὐτὸν εἰς τὸ ἀπόκλεισμα καὶ εἰς τὸν καταράκτην .
traditions.VUL: ut mittas eum in nervum et in cárcerem .
traditions.KJV: that thou shouldest put him in prison , and in the stocks .

27.english_reference: Now therefore why hast thou not reproved Jeremiah of Anathoth , which maketh himself a prophet to you ?

traditions.WLC: וְ עַתָּ֗ה לָ֚ מָּה לֹ֣א גָעַ֔רְתָּ בְּ יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ הָֽ עֲנְּתֹתִ֑י הַ מִּתְנַבֵּ֖א לָ כֶֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ νῦν διὰ τί συνελοιδορήσατε Ἰερεμίαν τὸν ἐξ Ἀναθὼθ τὸν προφητεύσαντα ὑμῖν ;
traditions.VUL: Et nunc quare non increpásti Ieremíam Anathothíten , qui prophétat vobis ?
traditions.KJV: Now therefore why hast thou not reproved Jeremiah of Anathoth , which maketh himself a prophet to you ?

28.english_reference: For therefore he sent unto us [ in ] Babylon , saying ,

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י עַל כֵּ֞ן שָׁלַ֥ח אֵלֵ֛י נוּ בָּבֶ֥ל לֵ אמֹ֖ר
traditions.LXX: οὐ διὰ τοῦτο ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς ὑμᾶς εἰς Βαβυλῶνα λέγων
traditions.VUL: Quia super hoc misit in Babylónem ad nos , dicens :
traditions.KJV: For therefore he sent unto us [ in ] Babylon , saying ,

28.english_reference: This [ captivity is ] long : build ye houses , and dwell [ in them ] ;

traditions.WLC: אֲרֻכָּ֣ה הִ֑יא בְּנ֤וּ בָתִּים֙ וְ שֵׁ֔בוּ
traditions.LXX: Μακράν ἐστιν , οἰκοδομήσατε οἰκίας καὶ κατοικήσατε ,
traditions.VUL: Longum est : ædificáte domos , et habitáte :
traditions.KJV: This [ captivity is ] long : build ye houses , and dwell [ in them ] ;

28.english_reference: and plant gardens , and eat the fruit of them .

traditions.WLC: וְ נִטְע֣וּ גַנּ֔וֹת וְ אִכְל֖וּ אֶת פְּרִי הֶֽן
traditions.LXX: καὶ φυτεύσατε κήπους καὶ φάγεσθε τὸν καρπὸν αὐτῶν ;
traditions.VUL: et plantáte hortos , et comédite fructus eórum .
traditions.KJV: and plant gardens , and eat the fruit of them .

29.english_reference: And Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the ears of Jeremiah the prophet .

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקְרָ֛א צְפַנְיָ֥ה הַ כֹּהֵ֖ן אֶת הַ סֵּ֣פֶר הַ זֶּ֑ה בְּ אָזְנֵ֖י יִרְמְיָ֥הוּ הַ נָּבִֽיא
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνέγνω Σοφονίας τὸ βιβλίον εἰς τὰ ὦτα Ἰερεμίου .
traditions.VUL: Legit ergo Sophonías sacérdos librum istum in áuribus Ieremíæ prophétæ .
traditions.KJV: And Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the ears of Jeremiah the prophet .

30.english_reference: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah , saying ,

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יְהִי֙ דְּבַר יְהוָ֔ה אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ לֵ אמֹֽר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος Κυρίου πρὸς Ἰερεμίαν λέγων
traditions.VUL: Et factum est verbum Dómini ad Ieremíam , dicens :
traditions.KJV: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah , saying ,

31.english_reference: Send to all them of the captivity , saying ,

traditions.WLC: שְׁלַ֤ח עַל כָּל הַ גּוֹלָה֙ לֵ אמֹ֔ר
